packageRules.description: iSponsorBlockTV, pinned by tag and digest in docker-compose.yml: every update (major too) auto-merges once CI passes. Renovate merges it itself after checking the commit's status checks (platformAutomerge off), so a red or pending CI never merges. Merging to main deploys.
Our Python dependencies: one grouped PR, never auto-merged (a pyytlounge update needs a real-TV check).
The api image's base and the CI actions: PRs for review, not auto-merged.
